The Elite Business Bay 2BR is available and ready for tomorrow, here's the listing with all the photos: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-elite-business-bay-residence-2Q6stHMYs0u.html
